definition: Ascribes φ a means that φ attributes the theory’s relevant evaluative property to act a. DescriptiveTruth requires Holds φ iff that property holds of a. For Railton it is Right; for Boyd positive GoodAct. Ascribes need not cover every sentence; neither belief nor truth-aptness entails truth. The finite model has both true and false ascriptions.
